description: Distribute supplied nonintersecting edges to their intersected leaves using opposite Z-order frontier-stack sweeps.

source.title: An Edge Quadtree for External Memory
source.section: Section 3, An algorithm for edge distribution when k=1; Distributing edges of positive and negative slope
source.pinned_behavior: Process E+ and E- separately in their respective Z orders. Maintain the SL/SB frontier stacks; pop incoming edges at each cell, report them and local starts, dispatch continuing edges by exit side, and transfer stack tops to restore the next frontier invariant.

contract.operation: Return the cell-incidence bitmask for each supplied canonical K-quadtree leaf.
contract.domain: Closed square [0,256] x [0,256]; input edge endpoints are interior integer points in [0,255]^2.
contract.positive_morton_digit: 2*x_bit+y_bit for coordinate bits 7 through 4, most significant first
contract.input_cell_order: Increasing positive Morton interval start; the cells form a complete prefix-free partition.
contract.partition_rule: Each leaf has at most one endpoint; each represented internal prefix has endpoints in at least two immediate children. With n=0, only root (0,0) is valid.
contract.edge_order: Normalize endpoints from smaller x to larger x; vertical edges are ordered from smaller y to larger y. E+ iff dy>0 (including vertical); E- iff dy<0.
contract.general_position: Distinct endpoints; no horizontal edge; no endpoint coordinate is divisible by 16; edges are pairwise disjoint and pass through no depth-four grid vertex.
contract.negative_morton_order: Rotate the sweep frame by (x′,y′)=(256−y,x), equivalently remap positive digits SW->2,NW->0,SE->3,NE->1; sort transformed cell intervals and write masks in original cell-ID order.
contract.frontier_construction: Refine cells to 16x16 depth-four atoms. At each cut, mark earlier cells processed; each x-column is a bottom prefix and h[x] is its processed height. The nonincreasing h profile defines B_j from northwest to southeast, including perimeter extensions. The current lower-left cell corner splits B_j into source left-boundary-to-corner and corner-to-bottom portions.
contract.stack_profile: For each sign, scan cells and start-sorted edges in its sweep frame. SL/SB hold active edges whose unique B_j crossing lies on the first/second frontier portions, ordered along the boundary. Pop intersecting stack tops, merge them with starts in the cell, emit incidences, dispatch continuing edges by exact top/right exit in upper-right order, then transfer stack tops according to the next cell's lower-left-corner movement until the top crossing remains on its required B_(j+1) portion.
contract.output_layout: [c,mask_0,...,mask_(c-1)]; bit j is set iff edge j intersects the closed cell.
contract.output_encoding: Signed 64-bit words in little-endian byte order
contract.validation_order: Validate input before checking output nullness/capacity; do not write on error.

workspace.accounting: Conservative 64-bit-index peak is about 10.9 KiB with parser arrays, sweep arrays, and nested frontier construction arrays live together; rounded to 16,384 bytes for scalar temporaries, alignment, and ABI-local bookkeeping. Excludes caller input and output buffers.
